classification: removes a markup span whose content is UNCONSTRAINED by the pattern
what_changes: `_DATA_IMG_RE`'s trailing `[^>]*` covers the whole rest of the tag, including an `alt` attribute; at the PRODUCTION default threshold (max_len=25,000, no override), an oversized image whose `alt` text carries a money-shaped token has that token removed along with the image
what_does_not_change: the surrounding text outside the image tag
semantics_note: MAJOR-1: falsifies the row's original claim that the regex 'never overlaps a money- or date-shaped printed token'; the digit_run tokens are the MIME-label/threshold-length artifacts from this census's own extractor (see the sibling oversized_dropped fixture's note), not printed figures -- the money token IS a printed figure and IS destroyed. This is why strip_oversized_embedded_images is excluded from METADATA_ONLY_LABEL
